# Wang QP Lab — Laboratory of Metabolism and Aging

> Laboratory of Prof. Qiao-Ping Wang at the School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Sun Yat-sen University (Shenzhen). We study the mechanisms of obesity, taste perception, aging and sleep, with a focus on energy-metabolism regulation and anti-aging drug discovery.

## About

- Principal Investigator: Qiao-Ping Wang (王巧平), Professor and Doctoral Supervisor
- Affiliation: School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Sun Yat-sen University, Shenzhen, China
- Research areas: energy homeostasis and glucose metabolism; target discovery and drug development for metabolic diseases; neurobiology of taste and feeding; functional genomics and AI-assisted drug discovery
- Selected journals: Cell Metabolism, Nature Communications, Nature Protocols, Advanced Science, Cell Reports, Diabetologia
